purpose: Prevent researcher choice of a favorable operation inside an already-frozen candidate repository.
procedure: Identify the target artifact's publicly exposed mutating operations within the candidate discovery slot without consulting issue or bug trackers.
Canonicalize operation names to lowercase ASCII and sort lexicographically.
For each operation in that order, identify the corresponding source-system operation using public documentation or source evidence.

The first operation whose source semantics contain a material version, revision, ETag, commit/object identity, resourceVersion, state lineage/serial, or equivalent precondition relevant to the effect becomes the candidate operation.

If the target operation cannot be reproducibly pinned, cannot be mapped to a source operation, or the source version distinction is not consequence-defining under a bounded declaration, continue to the next operation in lexical order.
If no operation qualifies, reject the candidate with a protocol-grounded reason and continue to the next candidate in hash order.
Do not run RISU Verify, inspect RISU C/D/O or Exact output, or consult target issue/bug trackers until the enrollment decision is committed.
change_control: Do not edit in place after detailed eligibility screening begins. Any change requires a numbered amendment with the screening state recorded.
